```{python}
import json
from pathlib import Path

import pandas as pd
import yaml
from IPython.display import Image, Markdown, display

ROOT = Path(root)
cfg = yaml.safe_load((ROOT / "config/config.yaml").read_text())
fit = json.loads((ROOT / "results/fit_mass.json").read_text())
summary = pd.read_csv(ROOT / "results/summary.csv")
cutflows = {
    s: json.loads((ROOT / f"work/selected/{s}.cutflow.json").read_text())
    for s in cfg["samples"]
}
labels = {s: c.get("label", s) for s, c in cfg["samples"].items()}


def table(df, **kw):
    # les | (ex. "|eta| < 2.5") casseraient le tableau markdown ; NaN -> case vide
    df = df.astype(object).where(df.notna(), "")
    df = df.map(lambda v: v.replace("|", "\\|") if isinstance(v, str) else v)
    display(Markdown(df.to_markdown(index=False, **kw)))
```

## Configuration

```{python}
sel = cfg["selection"]
hist = cfg["histogram"]
source = "générées (mock)" if cfg.get("use_mock_data") else "réelles (`data/raw/`)"
display(Markdown(f"""
- Données : {source}, graine `{cfg['seed']}`
- Sélection : $p_T > {sel['pt_min']}$ GeV, $|\\eta| < {sel['abs_eta_max']}$,
  ${sel['mass_min']} < m < {sel['mass_max']}$ GeV
- Histogramme : `{hist['variable']}`, {hist['bins']} bins sur
  [{hist['range'][0]}, {hist['range'][1]}] GeV
"""))

table(pd.DataFrame(
    [
        {"Échantillon": labels[s], "Type": c["kind"], "Facteur d'échelle": c.get("scale", 1.0)}
        for s, c in cfg["samples"].items()
    ]
))
```

## Sélection des événements

```{python}
#| tbl-cap: "Cutflow (nombre brut d'événements après chaque coupure)"
rows = {}
for s, cf in cutflows.items():
    for step in cf["cutflow"]:
        rows.setdefault(step["cut"], {})[labels[s]] = step["n_raw"]
cut_df = pd.DataFrame.from_dict(rows, orient="index").rename_axis("Coupure").reset_index()
table(cut_df)
```

```{python}
#| tbl-cap: "Bilan par échantillon"
recap = summary.assign(sample=summary["sample"].map(labels))[
    ["sample", "kind", "n_generated", "n_selected", "efficiency", "sum_weights", "mass_mean", "mass_std"]
]
recap.columns = ["Échantillon", "Type", "Générés", "Sélectionnés", "Efficacité",
                 "Σ poids", "⟨m⟩ [GeV]", "σ(m) [GeV]"]
table(recap, floatfmt=".4g")
```

```{python}
#| fig-cap: "Distribution de masse après sélection"
display(Image(filename=str(ROOT / "results/summary_mass.png")))
```

## Fit du pic de masse

```{python}
m = fit["model"]
ok = "parameters" in fit
if not ok:
    display(Markdown(f"::: {{.callout-warning}}\nPas de fit : statut **{fit['status']}** "
                     f"(Σ poids = {fit['sum_weights']:.0f}).\n:::"))
else:
    display(Markdown(
        f"Modèle : signal **{m['signal']}** + fond **{m['background']}**, "
        f"ajusté sur `{fit['dataset']}` (Σ poids = {fit['sum_weights']:.0f}). "
        f"Statut : **{fit['status']}** (Minuit {fit['minuit_status']}, "
        f"qualité de covariance {fit['cov_quality']}), "
        f"$\\chi^2/\\mathrm{{ndf}} = {fit['chi2_ndf']:.2f}$ (ndf = {fit['ndf']})."
    ))
```

```{python}
#| fig-cap: "Résultat du fit"
display(Image(filename=str(ROOT / "results/fit_mass.png")))
```

```{python}
#| tbl-cap: "Paramètres ajustés"
truth = {k: v for k, v in (fit.get("truth") or {}).items() if v is not None}
par = pd.DataFrame(
    [
        {
            "Paramètre": name,
            "Valeur": p["value"],
            "Erreur": p["error"],
            "Vérité MC": truth.get(name),
            "Pull": (p["value"] - truth[name]) / p["error"] if name in truth and p["error"] else None,
        }
        for name, p in fit.get("parameters", {}).items()
    ]
)
if ok:
    if not truth:
        par = par.drop(columns=["Vérité MC", "Pull"])
    table(par, floatfmt=".4g")
```

```{python}
if fit.get("signal_over_error") is not None:
    display(Markdown(
        f"Signal extrait : $N_\\mathrm{{sig}}/\\sigma(N_\\mathrm{{sig}}) = {fit['signal_over_error']:.1f}$."
    ))
```
